title: Find your way around
goal: Move through a small lab tree and confirm where you are before you change anything.

cheatSheet.description: Print the working directory. The full path, not a guess.
List names in the current directory.
Include hidden names, the ones that start with a dot.
Long format: permissions, owner, size, and time.
Change directory. cd on its own returns home. cd .. goes up one level.

files.content:
G'day. Your week 1 brief is in labs/week1.
List a directory before you move into it.
Week 1 lives in the week1 directory.

Week 1 brief
------------
Find this folder, then list it in long format.
Do not delete anything in this lab.

tasks.prompt: Print the directory you are in.
tasks.hint: Three letters. It stands for print working directory.

tasks.prompt: List your home directory, including hidden names.
tasks.hint: ls on its own hides names that start with a dot. The flag is -a.
cd takes a path. You can go one folder at a time, or use labs/week1.

tasks.prompt: Print the directory again so you can see the full path.
tasks.hint: cd does not print the new path. Run pwd after you arrive.

tasks.prompt: List this directory in long format so you can see sizes and permissions.
tasks.hint: The long flag is -l. You can run it here, or pass the path labs/week1.

tasks.prompt: Go back to your home directory.
tasks.hint: cd with no path goes home. cd ~ and cd /home/student do the same.
